# files.ethz.ch

> > A file hosting and distribution service for ETH Zurich, currently experiencing server configuration issues.

files.ethz.ch is the institutional file repository and distribution platform for ETH Zurich. The site is currently returning IIS (Internet Information Services) error pages, indicating potential server misconfiguration or maintenance.

## Server Status & Errors
